ambiguities.question: What are these links — short/redirect links, one-time authentication or password-reset links, or access links to private files or documents?
ambiguities.why: Each builds a different system: a redirect service needs open-redirect and SSRF controls; a magic-link auth flow needs single-use consumption, short TTL and session establishment; a document share link needs per-object authorization, optional passwords and download auditing. The data model, endpoints and threat model do not overlap enough to build one and adapt it.

ambiguities.question: Should a link be usable by anyone who possesses it (capability URL), or must the recipient additionally authenticate and be matched to the link's intended identity?
ambiguities.why: Bearer-capability links need only entropy, TTL and revocation. Identity-bound links require an authentication gate, an owner/recipient column, an authorization check at resolution, and a different failure mode (403 vs 410) — a contract difference that cannot be retrofitted without breaking issued links.

ambiguities.question: Are links that have already been issued by an existing (unsupplied) system required to keep working after the hardening?
ambiguities.why: The phrase 'more secure' implies a predecessor, but no code was supplied. If legacy tokens must resolve, the system needs a dual-path lookup and a migration/expiry window for weak tokens; if not, a single strong-token path ships and all old links break.

ambiguities.question: What default lifetime should a link have when the creator does not specify one?
ambiguities.why: Sets the default value of expires_at and the copy shown to users; cheap to change later via configuration.

ambiguities.question: Should a link be single-use (consumed on first successful resolution) or reusable until expiry?
ambiguities.why: Adds a used_at column and a consumption transaction; defaults differ by link type but the storage change is small and additive.

ambiguities.question: Should link resolution events be recorded for audit (who, when, from where)?
ambiguities.why: Determines whether an access-log table and retention policy exist; additive and does not alter the resolution contract.
